basic.name: Skeletal Swing
basic.description: Leoric swings his mace, dealing 150~~0.04~~ damage and Slowing enemies by 40% for 2.5 seconds. If an enemy Hero is hit, refund 50% of the cooldown and Mana cost. Deals 75% additional damage to Minions. Peasants!

basic.name: Drain Hope
basic.description: Grab an enemy Hero's soul, dealing up to 20% of their maximum Health as damage and healing Leoric for up to 20% of his maximum Health while he is nearby, over 4 seconds. Leoric's Movement Speed is reduced by 20% while this is active.

basic.name: Wraith Walk
basic.description: Leoric separates from his body, becoming Unstoppable and gaining Movement Speed accelerating up to 50% over 2.5 seconds. When Wraith Walk ends or is canceled, his body jumps to his wraith.

basic.name: Drain Essence
basic.description: Throw out a chain, attaching to the first enemy Hero hit, healing Leoric for up to 10% of his maximum Health over 4 seconds as long as the enemy remains close.

heroic.name: Entomb
heroic.description: Create an unpassable tomb for 4 seconds.

heroic.name: March of the Black King
heroic.description: Leoric becomes Unstoppable and walks forward, swinging his mace 3 times. Enemies hit take 250~~0.04~~ damage, and Heroes hit heal Leoric for 12% of his maximum Health.

trait.name: Undying
trait.description:
Leoric becomes a ghost when he dies, and resurrects upon reaching full Health. Leoric deals no damage while dead.

Wrath Of The Bone King

Leoric's first two Basic Attacks cleave for 100% damage, and his third Basic Attack deals 225% damage to a single target.

activable.name: Ossein Renewal
activable.description: Activate to heal Leoric for 30% of his maximum Health over 5 seconds. Regeneration Globes lower the cooldown of this Ability by 20 seconds.

activable.name: Shroud of the Dead King
activable.description: Activate to become Protected for 3 seconds, preventing all damage.

level1.name: Consume Vitality
level1.description: Skeletal Swing's cooldown is reduced by 2 seconds. Enemy Heroes hit heal Leoric for 4% of his maximum Health.

level1.name: Fealty Unto Death
level1.description: When a nearby friendly or enemy Minion dies, Leoric restores 32~~0.04~~ Health and 6 Mana.

level1.name: Ossein Renewal
level1.description: Activate to heal Leoric for 30% of his maximum Health over 5 seconds. Regeneration Globes lower the cooldown of this Ability by 20 seconds.

level4.name: Ghastly Reach
level4.description: Increase the range of Skeletal Swing by 25%.

level4.name: Paralyzing Rage
level4.description: Increase the Slow of Skeletal Swing by 20%.

level4.name: Kneel, Peasants!
level4.description: Skeletal Swing deals 75% additional damage to Mercenaries and Monsters, and hitting them activates Skeletal Swing's cost and cooldown refund.

level7.name: Willing Vessel
level7.description: Increase the healing from Drain Hope to 25% of Leoric's maximum Health. If Drain Hope lasts its full duration, Leoric instantly heals for an additional 5% of his maximum Health.

level7.name: Drain Momentum
level7.description: Drain Hope no longer reduces Leoric's Movement Speed. If Drain Hope lasts its full duration, gain 30% Movement Speed for 4 seconds.

level7.name: Hopelessness
level7.description: Increase the range of Drain Hope by 25%.

level10.name: Entomb
level10.description: Create an unpassable tomb for 4 seconds.

level10.name: March of the Black King
level10.description: Leoric becomes Unstoppable and walks forward, swinging his mace 3 times. Enemies hit take 250~~0.04~~ damage, and Heroes hit heal Leoric for 12% of his maximum Health.

level13.name: Unyielding Despair
level13.description: Drain Hope's cooldown is reduced by 0.75 seconds for every 1 second it is active. If Drain Hope lasts its full duration, its cooldown is reduced by an additional 2 seconds.

level13.name: Ominous Wraith
level13.description: Increase Wraith Walk's duration by 100%. Enemy Heroes that come in contact with the wraith deal 50% less damage for 4 seconds.

level13.name: Spectral Leech
level13.description: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes deal bonus damage to the primary target damage equal 2.5% of the Hero's maximum Health and heal Leoric for 200% of the bonus damage dealt.

level16.name: Crushing Hope
level16.description: If Drain Hope lasts its full duration, it instantly deals an additional 15% of the target's maximum Health as damage. This damage does not heal Leoric.

level16.name: Royal Focus
level16.description: Wraith Walk increases the damage of the next Skeletal Swing within 5 seconds by 50%. Each enemy Hero hit by Skeletal Swing reduces the cooldown of Wraith Walk by 7 seconds.

level16.name: Mithril Mace
level16.description:
Increase Leoric's Attack Speed by 20%.

Repeatable Quest: Nearby enemy Minion deaths grant 0.3% permanent Attack Speed, and Takedowns grant 3% permanent Attack Speed, up to 30%.

level20.name: Buried Alive
level20.description: The duration of Entomb is lowered by 1 second, but enemies trapped inside are Silenced and take 50~~0.04~~ damage every 1 second.

level20.name: Death March
level20.description: The final swing of March of the Black King also applies Drain Hope to nearby enemy Heroes.

level20.name: Burning Despair
level20.description:
Deal 40~~0.04~~ damage per second to nearby enemies. 

While Drain Hope is active, gain 40 Armor and the damage and area is increased by 100%.

level20.name: Shroud of the Dead King
level20.description: Activate to become Protected for 3 seconds, preventing all damage.
